notes: A song that is playing now asks the phone to stay awake for it, so leaving the app no longer freezes the page and kills the sound.
The loop that puts a silenced song back and keeps the notification, the lock screen and the saved place current is no longer paused when the screen goes off.
A song playing in your pocket and a download running at the same time share one hold, so neither one releases the phone while the other still needs it.
